breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains both water at 100°C and Hv = 0.3 m, directly repeating the original error. At 100°C, the vapor pressure head of water is approximately 10.3 m (near atmospheric), not 0.3 m. The agent made no correction—neither adjusting Hv to ~10.3 m nor changing the temperature to a lower value where Hv ≈ 0.3 m would be physically consistent.
